title: Onboarding quickstart: Troubleshooting visuals for rate limits, timeouts, and retries
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a set of onboarding and quickstart visual assets that illustrate common runtime error states and troubleshooting steps: rate limiting, request timeouts, transient server errors, and recommended retry/backoff behavior. Assets will be used in the Quickstart docs, Console help panels, and release notes. The goal is to reduce first-touch confusion for new developers integrating Redwood APIs and to provide clear next steps for self-service remediation.
design_notes: Produce 3 layout variants for each error type: inline banner (small width, for quickstarts), modal/dialog (for Console), and static doc illustration (full-width). Each variant should include: 1) a primary visual depicting the error cause (e.g., rate bucket filling, clock for timeout, broken connection for transient errors), 2) short microcopy (30-80 chars) with suggested action, 3) a CTA/button mock (e.g., Retry, Increase Quota, Inspect Logs), 4) secondary collapsed troubleshooting steps (two lines). Include a subtle animation frame set for the retry/backoff flow (3 frames). Use Redwood design tokens: core palette, token names indicated in visual_spec. Prioritize compact copy to fit mobile doc view. Provide SVGs and PNG exports at 1x/2x and Figma source with frames named for engineers to pull.
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct error visual families: rate_limit, timeout, retryable_error
Each family has inline banner, modal, and doc-illustration variants
Accessible color contrast for text and icons (AA minimum) and alt text for all assets
Figma file exported with layers named for export automation
Example screenshots of assets embedded into Quickstart doc hero and Console help panel mock
Hand-off notes with required asset sizes and SVG optimization guidelines
assets_requested: SVG icon set (rate-bucket, stopwatch, connection-broken, retry-arrow)
Three-frame animated GIFs for retry backoff (small, medium, large sizes)
High-res PNG exports for documentation and release notes
Figma source with componentized banners and tokens
accessibility_considerations: Text contrast >= AA for body and CTA
All graphics must include descriptive alt text strings in handoff
Animations default to reduced-motion when OS preference is set
Icons must be perceivable at 16px and 24px sizes

visual_spec: Primary colors: --rw-blue-600 for CTAs, --rw-red-500 for error accents, --rw-gray-100 background for banners. Icon stroke: 1.5px. Spacing token: unit-8 for internal padding. Banner height: 56px (inline), Modal illustration max-height: 220px, Doc full-width art: 680px wide. Typographic scale: H4 20px / Body 14px. Animation cadence: 240ms per frame for retry backoff with easing 'cubic-bezier(.22,.98,.35,1)'.
